description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Search open federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov notices, presented as cards. Uses the same stored-notice engine as search_open_notices - one call, one search - with results sorted by posted date or deadline, not by a match score. Each card shows deadlines, the filter that matched it (e.g. the NAICS or set-aside you passed), and source links. Present as information only; not a bid recommendation. Cite the source link when available; legacy DIBBS records without verified deep links retain the source name and record ID. For a known current or previous solicitation/reference number, use solicitation_number; for a SAM notice ID use notice_id. These exact lookups include stored closed/archived records, do not inherit the browsing set-aside default, and do not search award contract PIIDs. Stored records are not a complete live-source or version-history search. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use.

agency.description: Literal substring of the recorded agency path, including its named offices. This is separate from performance geography; clarify ambiguous abbreviations before choosing constraints.
agency.title: Agency

cursor.description: Returned continuation cursor. Keep the same search filters; changed matching records require restarting the search.
cursor.title: Cursor

geography.description: State where the work is performed, e.g. TX for Texas; matches recorded structured place of performance, not buyer address or title text. Records with unknown work state are excluded.
geography.title: Geography

keywords.description: Literal text in stored titles, briefs, current-version fetched scope, inline source descriptions, solicitation numbers and notice IDs. URL-only and known stale descriptions are excluded; filtered before scan and result limits.
keywords.title: Keywords

limit.description: Maximum 25 opportunity leads; minimum 1; default 10. Stored versions remain grouped.
limit.title: Limit

notice_id.description: Exact SAM notice ID, a separate identifier from solicitation numbers and award PIIDs. Includes stored closed notices. Omit browsing filters.
notice_id.title: Notice Id

set_aside.description: Recorded notice restriction: vosb (veteran-owned), sdvosb (service-disabled veteran-owned), 8a, hubzone, wosb, edwosb, small. VOSB and SDVOSB are distinct; do not infer a firm's credentials. Omit or pass null for any set-aside; unrestricted requires affirmative source evidence of full/open competition and excludes unknown restrictions. This filter does not establish company certification.
set_aside.title: Set Aside

solicitation_number.description: Exact current/previous solicitation or reference number; case, spaces and hyphens normalized. Includes stored closed notices. Omit browsing filters. Not an award PIID.
solicitation_number.title: Solicitation Number

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Follow coverage.continuation using its named tool and the same search filters. If the tool reports changed matching records, restart the search without a cursor. Results cover a bounded stored scan, not a frozen live-source snapshot.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
